programme.title: Runner Runner
programme.desc: Richie is ervan overtuigd dat hij is opgelicht tijdens het online pokeren. Hij besluit om naar Costa Rica te reizen om Ivan Block, de eigenaar van de gokwebsite, te confronteren.

programme.title: The Blackout
programme.desc: Als de aarde wordt getroffen door een onbekend, buitenaards verschijnsel is alle communicatie in een klap verbroken. Een klein gebied in Oost-Europa heeft als enige plek nog elektriciteit..

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.desc: Lahemaa National Park on Estonias Baltic coast features ancient forests, rivers and peninsulas where nature has remained largely untouched.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks

programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

Blinding punches and the snake feint - one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning - and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots - following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Shunde's Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong - a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter - that's the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more..

programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: De groep ontdekt dat Ranmaru en Karashi ontbreken in de currywinkel.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Rennen! De boog van het leven!
programme.desc: Lee wordt alleen gelaten tegenover Raiga terwijl Tenten en de anderen zich haasten om hen de curry des levens te brengen. Ranmaru wordt herenigd met Raiga, maar zijn de dingen nog hetzelfde als voorheen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Volg mij! De grote overlevingsuitdaging
programme.desc: Elke Genin krijgt een groep kadetten toegewezen om te leiden tijdens een missie die hen allemaal dwingt naar de top van een berg te racen om een boekrol terug te halen en, raad eens wie Naruto uiteindelijk leidt? Het is niemand minder dan het Konohamaru-korps. Maar wanneer een storm ervoor zorgt dat de missie wordt afgeblazen zonder dat hij het weet, zal hij een betere leider dan ooit moeten zijn om zijn team in leven te houden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De premiejager uit de wildernis
programme.desc: Naruto, Hinata en Kiba worden op een missie gestuurd om een dief genaamd Gosunkugi te vangen. Onderweg ontmoeten ze echter een andere premiejager, die achter hetzelfde doel aanzit als zij.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Jagen of opgejaagd worden? Showdown bij de O.K. Tempel!
programme.desc: Het blijkt dat Sazanami eigenlijk een gezochte crimineel genaamd Toukichi is, die gezocht wordt voor de moord op een gezin van drie kinderen. De waarheid is echter dat hij onschuldig is en om dat te bewijzen wil hij de verantwoordelijke man vangen. Sazanami vormt een team met de Konoha-groep om Gosunki voor eens en altijd te stoppen..

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Terwijl Gai en Lee Konoha verlaten voor een missie, vermommen twee vreemdelingen zich als hen en sluipen het dorp binnen om achter de geheimen te komen. Tsunade, Sakura en Tenten hebben grote plannen met deze bedriegers, plannen die hun leven zuur zullen maken.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto, Tenten en Neji reizen naar Bird Country om een geest genaamd Noroimusha uit te roeien.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De intentie van de tacticus
programme.desc: Naruto en de anderen proberen te bewijzen dat Kouhmei verantwoordelijk is voor de geest. Wat Naruto en de bende ontdekken laat echter nog meer mysteries onopgelost.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto besluit zelf op onderzoek uit te gaan over de kwestie van de geest, terwijl Neji en Tenten een andere aanpak proberen. Met de hulp van twee kikkers, begint Naruto meer en meer te leren over de waarheid van de zaak....maar wat hij ontdekt, zal hem zijn leven kosten.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Kakashi beveelt Neji en Tenten om met hem terug te keren naar het dorp, tot hun grote protest. Ondertussen staat Koumei op het punt geëxecuteerd te worden, tenminste totdat de Noroimusha opduikt. Is de geest een bondgenoot of een vijand en wat is er van Naruto geworden? Vragen worden beantwoord als Sagi de waarheid onthult.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Sagi bereidt zijn wraakplannen voor en laat niemand hem in de weg staan. Vermomd als de Noroimusha confronteert hij Musou, maar schokkend nieuws wordt onthuld wanneer ze allebei hun ware identiteit onthullen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Als zilverreigers met hun vleugels flapperen
programme.desc: Shima redt Naruto uit Ooki's genjutsu-val en probeert hem te beschermen. Als alles verloren lijkt voor onze held, verschijnt er een mysterieuze witte figuur die hem vraagt een laatste wens te vervullen. Zal Naruto de kracht vinden om dit verzoek in te willigen en de dag te redden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Meng het, rek het uit, kook het ! Brand koperen ketel, brand!
programme.desc: Meneer Ichiraku, de eigenaar van de Ichiraku Ramen winkel zit in de problemen. Zijn dochter is ontvoerd en hij heeft maar twee dagen om haar terug te winnen. Kunnen Nauruto, Chouji en Sakura meneer Ichiraku helpen de wedstrijd te winnen, of moet hij zijn legendarische Ramen-recept afstaan.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Als een van de weinige beschikbare Genins worden Naruto, Ino en Shino gedwongen om Anko te vergezellen op haar missie naar Sea Country om een zeemonster te vernietigen en een boot met goud te beschermen. Anko gedraagt zich echter vreemd als ze zich steeds meer gebeurtenissen uit haar verleden begint te herinneren en de band die ze ooit had met Orochimaru.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto herstelt dankzij het mysterieuze meisje Isaribi. Terwijl Naruto herstelt, gaan Anko, Shino en Ino naar hem op zoek en ontmoeten ze ook de man die verantwoordelijk is voor de lonen. De groep komt uiteindelijk weer bij elkaar, maar niet voordat ze het hol van het zeemonster hebben gevonden.

programme.title: Naruto - Ninja Clash in the Land Of Snow
programme.desc: Naruto en zijn team zijn op een missie gestuurd om Yukie Fujikaze te bewaken, een populaire actrice uit de hitfilm The Adventures of Princess Gale. De ploeg is op weg naar het Land van Sneeuw, een land voor altijd bedekt met sneeuw, om de laatste scènes van de film op te nemen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Nadat Isaribi is ontsnapt, besluiten Naruto en zijn team naar het verboden eiland te gaan en Orochimaru en zijn ondergeschikten te confronteren. Ze ontdekken al snel dat Orochimaru niet de man achter het gordijn is, maar een man die bekend staat als Amachi. Amachi is degene die Isaribi in een monster heeft veranderd, dus waarom helpt zij hem.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Na ternauwernood aan het instortende lab te zijn ontsnapt, moeten Naruto en de anderen het geldkonvooi inhalen. Amachi heeft echter zijn val al gezet en de bemanning van het konvooi heeft toegehapt. Naruto en de anderen arriveren om de dag te redden, terwijl ze zich allemaal voorbereiden op de strijd. Maar kan de groep Amachi verslaan als hij zijn ware ik onthult? En wat gebeurt er als Isaribi beseft hoe ver Naruto zal gaan om haar te redden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Strijd op zee: De ontketende kracht!
programme.desc: Het gevecht tussen Naruto en Amachi loopt vrij snel ten einde, of toch niet? Anko krijgt ook meer van haar verleden terug, inclusief een belangrijke gebeurtenis.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Onmogelijk! Beroemde Ninja-kunst: Geldstijl Jutsu!
programme.desc: Naruto gidst Kunijiro, een jonge rijke jongen die Tsunade bezoekt, door een dag uit het leven van een ninja.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De jacht op de schat is begonnen!
programme.desc: Naruto, Kiba en Hinata worden op een speciale missie gestuurd: Een schattenjacht. Er is echter een nadeel: als ze niet slagen voor de missie, moeten ze terug naar de Academy. Ze vertrekken vol vertrouwen dat de missie makkelijk zal zijn, maar zijn nog steeds bezorgd dat ze terug moeten naar de academie. Alles gaat zo goed als verwacht, totdat er mysterieuze figuren opduiken. Kunnen Naruto en zijn team het goud vinden, of moeten ze terug naar de Academie met de andere kleine kinderen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Rennen, ontwijken, Zigzaggen! Achtervolgen of achtervolgd worden!
programme.desc: Naruto, Kiba en Hinata moeten terug naar Konoha en voorkomen dat hun kwaadaardige look-a-likes hun dorp ruïneren. De bedriegers denken dat het een makkelijke taak zal zijn, maar wanneer de echte Naruto en Kiba hun zwakte blootleggen, ontdekken ze dat het misschien niet zo makkelijk is.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto ontmoet per ongeluk Jiraiya en eist dat hij hem traint. Jiraiya weigert echter, omdat hij het volgende deel van zijn serie moet afmaken. Naruto wil dolgraag trainen en probeert te helpen, maar zoals gewoonlijk gaat het mis. Naruto en Jiraiya vs de Courier Ninja, wie komt er als winnaar uit de bus.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Ontmoeting! De jongen met de naam van een ster
programme.desc: Ongeveer 200 jaar geleden viel er een ster in het Hidden Star Village. Deze ster zou mystieke krachten bezitten. Het dorp heeft echter weinig ninja's, dus hebben ze de hulp van andere dorpen nodig. Naruto vergezelt Lee, Neji en Tenten op een missie om de ster te beschermen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Het slaapliedje dat je je herinnert
programme.desc: Wanneer de mysterieuze aanvaller wegvliegt met de ster en alleen hun Chakra gebruikt, wordt de Konoha-groep in het stof achtergelaten. Ze zweren de ster terug te winnen, maar dat is niet zo eenvoudig als ze hopen. Ondertussen komt Naruto meer te weten over de geschiedenis van Subaru en Natsuhiboshi.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Verborgen Jutsu! De prijs van Ninja-kunst: Kujaku
programme.desc: Alles lijkt uit te lopen op een eindstrijd, maar wie is de echte vijand achter dit alles.

programme.desc: Kunnen de twee de lang geleden begonnen missie voortzetten en wat zal Subaru denken als hij de waarheid ontdekt.

programme.title: Peppe's Sicilië
programme.desc: Als de vis fantastisch vers moet zijn, dan trekken de inwoners van Siculiana naar Sciacca, een nabije havenstad. En daar gaat ook Peppe vandaag naartoe. De kleuren van de huizen, de talrijke vissersboten, de gezellig drukke bedrijvigheid tussen de vissers en hun klanten die rechtstreeks aan de boot kopen. Fantastisch. Peppe koopt er een kratje sardienen en maakt ze helemaal op z'n Siciliaans klaar. Hij dekt de tafel voor 2: voor hemzelf en voor de belangrijkste vrouw van Siculiana..

programme.title: Beach Barbecue
programme.desc: Chef Bart Desmidt haalt vandaag de barbecue van stal op het strand. Bart grilt een sappige lamsbout en combineert die met groene groenten en gremoulata. Ook op het strandmenu: een turkse pizza met lamsgehakt en een zeebaarsspies. De chef poft kraakverse kokkels op de barbecue en maakt er een oosters sausje bij. Op en top lekker beach food en een zomerse sfeer dus, in Beach Barbecue.

programme.title: Lekker Lang Leven
programme.desc: Aflevering 2 - Chef en diëtist Michaël Sels neemt ons mee naar Spanje voor zijn versie van de bekende gehaktballetjes Albondigas. Hij maakt er ook bloemkool bij met gezonde witte saus. Maar we starten de dag eerst met een healthy havermoutontbijtje.

programme.title: In de Mix
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza maakt klassieke spaghetti klaar, Jelle Beeckman serveert 'portie friet con carne', Dominique Persoone belegt brood met zalmtartaar en Jeroen De Pauw bereidt een puntpaprikasoepje. Het dessert? Cheesecake door Stephanie Bex.

programme.title: Lekker Messy
programme.desc: De broers starten hun vakantiedag licht en gezond met een pastasalade van gerookte paling, appel, munt en avocadodressing. Daarna springen ze op de trend van 'buttered chicken'. En als er boter in de naam zit, weet je dat het zal smaken.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Rund
programme.desc: Chef Johan Segers is vastberaden om alle geheimen te achterhalen die er bestaan over rundvlees. Vandaag wil hij traditioneel stoofvlees klaarmaken en hiervoor gaat hij langs bij zijn vaste slager, beenhouwer Benny Vermeulen. Zo komt de chef meer te weten over de eigenschappen van het vlees dat je voor stoverijen kan gebruiken en laat Benny hem met eigen ogen zien hoe je stoofvlees uit het voorkwartier van het rund snijdt. Daarna gaat onze chef aan de slag en maakt hij stoofvlees met gebakken appeltjes en gekookte aardappelen. Smullen maar.

programme.title: De Smaaktoerist
programme.desc: In het Hageland vind je heerlijke streekproducten. Dat weet ook Smaaktoerist Jeroen. Denk maar aan de pensen van Vangramberen en de pikante saus van Hilko. De perfecte ingrediënten voor streetfood. En: nog lekkerder met bier uit Bierbeek.

programme.title: Vlaanderen kookt
programme.desc: Vlamingen zijn Bourgondiërs. Ze weten dat eten een warm en sociaal gebeuren is.Elk gezin heeft wel een speciaal gerecht waar het trots op is. Een specialiteit die ze maar al te graag delen met vrienden en kennissen. Een recept dat een plaats verdient in een kookboek.

programme.title: Njam_NJ00006265_01_0002_B0_HD_HD_S_OSNL_A
programme.desc: De beroemde chef-kok Ainsley Harriott onderzoekt op een reis rond de wereld de relatie tussen plaatselijk straatvoedsel en culturele identiteit. In Barbados proeft Ainsley pittige sauzen, bezoekt hij rumwinkels en probeert hij indruk te maken op Barbadanen met zijn kookkunsten.

programme.title: Toasted
programme.desc: Gorgeous Goddess / Holy Mackerel / Magic Mushroom Toast - Mix de looks van de IJslandse Dagny Ros Asmundsdottir met de rock-'n-rol van chocolatier Dominique Persoone en je krijgt magie op je bord. Zeker om 8u30. Ook deze ochtend zit hun hippe ontbijtbar goed vol. Vandaag maakt Dagny Ros een vitaminebom in vloeibare vorm en een stevige gezonde boterham met knolselder en makreel, helemaal naar Scandinavisch receptuur. Dominique pakt het liever wat vettiger, zotter en steviger aan en zorgt voor een Magic Mushroom Toast..

programme.title: De Hofleverancier
programme.desc: Tomaat - In 'De Hofleverancier' keert driesterrenchef Gert De Mangeleer terug naar de basis van zijn keuken: kraakverse groenten, die met liefde gekweekt en verzorgd worden door zijn culinair onderlegde tuinman Bart Praet. Op de boerderij bekijken ze samen welke groente er op dat moment in haar topseizoen is en ter plaatse maakt Gert telkens drie gerechten klaar, die deze groente op een magische manier doen schitteren in haar eenvoud. Op het einde geeft Gert deze toegankelijke gerechten telkens een driesterrentoets door ze op een prachtige wijze te dresseren op het bord, met hier en daar een speciale bloem of een lekker kruid uit de tuin.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats the Streets
programme.desc: De beroemde chef-kok Ainsley Harriott onderzoekt op een reis rond de wereld de relatie tussen plaatselijk straatvoedsel en culturele identiteit. In Istanboel probeert Ainsley oude en intrigerende smaken uit voordat hij zijn eigen draai geeft aan een klassiek lokaal gerecht.

programme.title: In de Mix
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza maakt klassieke spaghetti klaar, Jelle Beeckman serveert 'portie friet con carne', Dominique Persoone belegt brood met zalmtartaar en Jeroen De Pauw bereidt een puntpaprikasoepje. Het dessert? Cheesecake door Stephanie Bex.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Vandaag gaat Timon voor old school vlees dat helemaal weer in is: varkenswangen. Die tovert hij om tot heerlijke pulled pork taco's. Daarna serveert hij pinsa met Arabische toppings zoals spicy lamsgehakt, frisse yoghurt en groene kruiden.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Vader Bert Meewis kiest voor een klassieke bereiding van duif met een heerlijke saus, terwijl zoon Giel Meewis verrast met een gedurfde interpretatie: een krokant eitje van duif met de saus van zijn vader én rood gekleurde zilveruitjes.

programme.title: Op Hete Kolen
programme.desc: Vandaag komt er familie op bezoek bij onze barbecue chef: zijn broer en zus komen langs met hun partners en met het kleine neefje en nichtje van Michaël. Onze hippe chef kiest vandaag voor een op en top zomers barbecue gerecht: geroosterd buikspek met verse guacamole. Hierbij serveert hij nog een fris slaatje met rucola én leert hij ons een truc om je mayonaise een echte barbecue rooksmaak te geven. Als top of the bill flanst hij ook nog een geroosterde bruschetta met kip en aubergine in elkaar en maakt hij ook nog een gevulde worst voor de kindjes. Alvast één ding staat vast: er is genoeg voor iedereen.

programme.title: Karola's Kitchen
programme.desc: Ben jij iemand die denkt: soep is saai? Karolien bewijst het tegendeel met haar pindanoedelsoep met gemarineerde eitjes. Die vult, is voedzaam en vooral: verrassend lekker. Ze sluit af met een teriyaki notenmix en een frisse mocktail. Njam.

programme.title: Over (H)eerlijke Groenten
programme.desc: Vandaag is Johan Segers op zoek naar verse bloemkool en die vindt hij bij Linda Van Dessel. Met deze kraakverse bloemkool maakt hij eerst een bloemkoolsoep met stilton en daarna een brandade van bloemkool met cipolata en een spiegeleitje.

programme.title: Tot op het Bot: Het Varken
programme.desc: Onze chef Johan Segers kiest vandaag voor één van de populairste zomerproducten van elke beenhouwer: varkensribbekes. Slager Benny legt aan Johan uit welke andere ribben er naast de spare ribs nog bestaan en waarvoor je ze best gebruikt. Daarna beent Benny een paar prachtige ribben uit, en op vraag van onze chef laat hij er genoeg vlees aan zodat Johan er heerlijk van kan peuzelen. Bij de ribbekes serveert de chef een aardappel in de schil met een heerlijke zelfgemaakte kruidenboter.

programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi is forced to face Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus, in the mysterious Shadow Realm where all the monsters and magic are real. If Yugi loses, Pegasus claims Grandpa’s soul as his prize.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya’s battle with Declan takes a turn for the worse when Declan’s majestic monsters give Yuya the royal treatment.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It’s a family feud when Yuya takes on his mom in a duel where there’s more to lose than just his allowance! Can Yuya avoid being run down by Paradise City’s most feared motorcycle momma.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle between Yuya and his mom kicks into high gear! Can Yuya avoid being grounded, or will Loco Yoko put the pedal to the metal and throttle her way to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Zuzu and Yugo try to unravel the riddle of Yuya's dimensional doubles, their sleuthing is cut short by Sector Security.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Zuzu and Yugo redline their Duel Runner in a high-stakes Turbo Duel with Sector Security! Can they outrun the long arm of the law, or will Security put the brakes on their escape.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It’s time for the World Duel Carnival Finals! But prepare for a world of twists and turns because the finalists will be dueling on a roller coaster! Can Yuma handle the ups and downs of the competition, or will he be sent for a loop?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To assess Yuma’s dueling skills, Vetrix hires the Triad of Terror, a trio of cunning card sharks, to triple team him! Yuma better figure out a way to roll through this threesome before his dueling goes off the rails.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival takes a dark turn as the finalists descend into the Dragon’s Den – a dark and dangerous duel track that will bring defeat for many a duelist! Can Yuma make his way through the treacherous track, or will the Dragon’s Den deliver a knockout blow?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The heat's on when Vetrix and Dextra duel in the jungle to decide who moves on to the World Duel Carnival semifinals.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Quinton takes a timeout during his duel against Kite to reveal the long hidden mystery about Yuma’s father’s disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh

programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: En tidligere elite agenten tar på seg et dobbelt oppdrag: å redde en kinesisk jente som har blitt bortført av Triaden, deretter bruke en sikker kombinasjon for å overliste den russiske mafiaen, korrupte NYC tjenestemenn, og Triaden selv.

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: År 2045. USA har blitt til en totalitær stat hvor regjeringen og dens leder, ganske enkelt kjent som «Diktatoren» (Steven Seagal), styrer hele befolkningens liv.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Following the Scottish West Coast with "Waverley"
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Shunde's Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong - a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter - that's the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more..

Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men

This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. programme.desc: In January 2022, Daniele Gatti conducted the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai at the Turin Auditorium, performing Wagner’s "Parsifal" excerpts and Bruckner’s Symphony No. 9. The programme highlighted Wagner's meditative Prelude to Act III and Good Friday Spell, followed by Bruckner’s profound Ninth Symphony, marked by its emotional depth and unfinished final movement.

programme.title: Into the Med: Malta an Island to Discover
programme.desc: Susannah takes you to the timeless magic of Malta’s former capital, Mdina, where centuries of history breathe within its ancient stone walls. She inhales the beautiful boulevards and rich cultural heritage of the city, as well as the fascinating underwater world of the Malta National Aquarium, learning about the diverse experiences that make the islands so special. Along the way, she discovers stunning views, incredible landmarks and stories that continue to shape Malta’s rich identity and indomitable spirit.

programme.title: Med Nations 02 Greece
programme.desc: Greece has a culture that has been shaped by hundreds of years of ideas, traditions, and life on the sea. From the ancient wonders of Athens to the sun-drenched islands of the Aegean, Greece shows this. This trip shows how Greece still inspires the Mediterranean and the world through its food, music, and long history.

programme.title: Isabella Turso Dimples
programme.desc: An Original Music Video by Isabella Turso.

programme.title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe

programme.title: Malini Angelica Sicily
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Sicily’s enchanting southeast, visiting Catania, Noto, Syracuse, and Ortigia. She dives into Catania’s lively fish market, samples local dishes like pasta alla norma and even horse meat burgers, and enjoys wine tasting in Noto’s vineyards. In Syracuse and Ortigia, she discovers stunning Greek ruins and seaside charm that showcase Sicily’s rich culture and history.

programme.title: Dates that made history
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 1324 Mansa Musas Pilgrimage To Mecca
programme.desc: Mansa Musa's Pilgrimage to Mecca explores the extraordinary journey of Mansa Musa, the emperor of Mali, to Mecca in 1324. Highlighting the wealth and power of the Mali Empire as Musa’s caravan traverses the Sahara, spreading wealth and religious influence. It examines the impact of his pilgrimage on both the Islamic world and Africa’s place in global history. Through this journey, Mansa Musa’s legacy of generosity and cultural exchange becomes legendary.

programme.desc: The tale of Prometheus, the Titan who defied Zeus by giving fire to humanity. His act of rebellion sparks divine punishment, as he is bound and tortured for eternity. Through striking imagery, the story reveals themes of sacrifice, defiance, and the price of progress.

programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels On The Air
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Baby
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels In The Wings
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi is forced to face Duel Monsters creator, Maximillion Pegasus, in the mysterious Shadow Realm where all the monsters and magic are real. If Yugi loses, Pegasus claims Grandpa’s soul as his prize.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya’s battle with Declan takes a turn for the worse when Declan’s majestic monsters give Yuya the royal treatment.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle between Yuya and his mom kicks into high gear! Can Yuya avoid being grounded, or will Loco Yoko put the pedal to the metal and throttle her way to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Zuzu and Yugo try to unravel the riddle of Yuya's dimensional doubles, their sleuthing is cut short by Sector Security.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Zuzu and Yugo redline their Duel Runner in a high-stakes Turbo Duel with Sector Security! Can they outrun the long arm of the law, or will Security put the brakes on their escape.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It’s time for the World Duel Carnival Finals! But prepare for a world of twists and turns because the finalists will be dueling on a roller coaster! Can Yuma handle the ups and downs of the competition, or will he be sent for a loop?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: To assess Yuma’s dueling skills, Vetrix hires the Triad of Terror, a trio of cunning card sharks, to triple team him! Yuma better figure out a way to roll through this threesome before his dueling goes off the rails.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The World Duel Carnival takes a dark turn as the finalists descend into the Dragon’s Den – a dark and dangerous duel track that will bring defeat for many a duelist! Can Yuma make his way through the treacherous track, or will the Dragon’s Den deliver a knockout blow?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The heat's on when Vetrix and Dextra duel in the jungle to decide who moves on to the World Duel Carnival semifinals.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Quinton takes a timeout during his duel against Kite to reveal the long hidden mystery about Yuma’s father’s disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The trickster Weevil Underwood spins a web of lies to bait Joey into a lopsided duel! programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: São Jorge
programme.desc: Jorge corre o risco de perder o filho e a mulher, quando esta decide regressar ao Brasil. Em desespero, aceita trabalho numa empresa de cobranças difíceis. Ironicamente, Jorge passa a intimidar aqueles que, como ele, se veem a braços com dívidas.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc:
Die Medicopter-Crew muss einen Mann aus einem Steinbruch retten, doch auf dem Gelände droht eine Sprengladung zu explodieren.

Währenddessen wird Dr. Lüdwitz von seinem Sohn Dirk um Hilfe gebeten. Dessen Freund Klaus, mit dem Dirk die Nacht heimlich im Wald verbracht hat, ist auf der Flucht vor seinem Vater in eine Felsspalte gestürzt.

Klaus' Vater Bodo hat vor Aufregung eine Herzattacke erlitten, und sein Zustand verschlechtert sich zunehmend. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc: Während einer Ballonfahrt mit seiner Tochter Kathi erleidet Erich Troger einen Herzinfarkt. Er kann den Ballon zwar landen, doch als er aus dem Korb fällt, verliert er das Bewusstsein.\n\nKathi treibt daraufhin hilflos mit dem Ballon ab. Die Retter halten Troger zunächst für einen Wanderer. Als sie das Mädchen in Not bemerken, ist die Rettung schwierig, denn der durch die Rotorblätter des Helikopters erzeugte Wind treibt den Ballon immer höher hinauf. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Medicopter 117 – Jedes Leben zählt
programme.desc: Drei Jungen spielen in einer stillgelegten Chemiefabrik mit einem gestohlenen Revolver. Dabei beschädigen sie ein Fass, in dem sich ein hochgiftiger Inhalt befindet.\n\nAuf der Flucht vor den giftigen Dämpfen stürzt der kleine Lasse und bleibt bewusstlos liegen. Weil sich das Tor der Fabrik nicht öffnen lässt, seilt sich die Notärztin Dr. Kollmann zu dem Jungen ab. Sie kann Lasse retten, doch dann kommt es zu einer verheerenden Explosion. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Waterstaatkundig ingenieur en medewerker van Rijkswaterstaat Johan van Veen schrijft al vroeg het eerste Deltaplan: ver vóór de watersnoodramp waarschuwt hij dat de dijken kunnen breken. Maar zijn woorden worden in de wind geslagen. Uit gesprekken met een dochter en een kleinzoon en tal van documenten blijkt dat Van Veen blijft waarschuwen. Maar het leidt allemaal tot niets. Ze vonden hem een drammer. Zijn plannen worden pas na de ramp ten uitvoer gebracht.

programme.desc: Een Oogje op Brabant is deze keer in Bergen op Zoom. Passanten en inwoners geven commentaar op de oude beelden van Bergen op Zoom. Deze keer in het cultuurmagazine Route C: Marinke van Zandwijk blaast glasbellen in alle soorten en maten. Op haar veertiende liep ze de glasblazerij in Leerdam in en daar is ze gebleven. In Op Oorlogspad nemen Hans Sakkers en Klaas van de Ketterij de kijker mee op reis door de provincie waar de sporen van de Slag om de Schelde nog duidelijk aanwezig zijn.

programme.title: Meisje met de parel - portret van een icoon
programme.desc: Het schilderij Meisje met de Parel van Johannes Vermeer is uitgegroeid tot een wereldwijd icoon. We duiken in de geschiedenis van het schilderij dat vaak De Mona Lisa van het Noorden wordt genoemd. Twee eeuwen lang is er geen spoor van haar te bekennen, tot ze eind negentiende eeuw zwaar vervuild opduikt op een veiling, waar ze voor twee gulden wordt verkocht. Het is het begin van een ongekende zegetocht. Tracy Chevalier, schrijfster van Girl with a Pearl Earring, komt aan het woord.

programme.title: Nu te Zien!
programme.desc: Directeur Margriet Schavemaker bespreekt deze keer een tentoonstelling in haar eigen Kunstmuseum Den Haag. Met de expositie Reflections on Fashion viert het museum het 75-jarige jubileum van zijn modecollectie, die inmiddels is uitgegroeid tot de grootste van Nederland. Van kostbare 17e-eeuwse pronkstukken tot hedendaagse eyecatchers rechtstreeks van de catwalk. Te zien zijn stukken van Coco Chanel, Fong-Leng, Alexander McQueen en Jan Taminiau.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Petra Grijzen volgt de eerste nationale Undiagnosed Hackathon voor zeldzame genetische ziektes. Krijgen de deelnemende 33 families met een zeldzame genetische aandoening eindelijk een diagnose? 140 wetenschappers proberen binnen 48 uur een antwoord te vinden. Ook duikt Petra in het verhaal van de familie Janssen, waarvan twee kinderen gehandicapt zijn. Zal de hackathon hen een diagnose (en hoop) geven?
