programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is lack of confidence holding you back in your life? Then join today’s guests and enroll in Dr. Phil’s confidence course. Meet one woman who has zero confidence in social situations and says she wishes she were more beautiful, like her identical twin sister! You’ll also meet an artist who used to weigh 500 pounds. He’s shed the weight, but hasn’t shed his fear of talking to women. Plus, will a classically trained pianist overcome her fear of performing in front of crowds? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is fed up with teens being terrorized -- both in the schoolyard and online -- and he’s putting bullies on notice! This summer, he took the battle against cyber bullies before Congress, and now he’s kicking off his own Anti-Bully Movement. Learn how cyber bullying is affecting 12-year-old Dara, and why her mom, Toni, fears the tween may harm herself if she doesn’t get help. Then, hear why Michael, a self-proclaimed cyber bully, defends his keyboard antics. Plus, Congresswoman Carolyn McCarthy weighs in on bullying and cyber bullying and what can be done about this growing epidemic, and Parry Aftab, executive director and founder of StopCyberBullying.org, shares tips to keep your kids safe. Join the movement, and take Dr. Phil’s pledge to fight the abuse!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God.".

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anything goes on “Ask Dr. Phil"! A 25-year-old claims she won’t find happiness until she becomes a millionaire…and would even ditch her loved ones to get it! Is her search for wealth unreasonable? Then, meet one empty nester who cries everyday about her daughter leaving for college—and it’s been four years! Also, you’ll be surprised to find out why one woman wouldn’t pick up the phone, even if her life depended on it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On today’s show, Dr. Phil looks at the roles of married couples. You may think her job looks easy, and she may think you don’t do a thing all day! Dr. Phil puts his own marriage to the test by switching daily routines with his wife, Robin. Can they handle the daily grind of each other’s lives? It’s not as easy as it looks to walk in your spouse’s shoes. You may even walk away from today’s episode with a little better perspective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues an intense discussion on negotiated infidelity. Chrissy, a mother of three, says her husband, Scott, refuses to dump his girlfriend and wants her to consider an open relationship. During their first appearance, things got heated when Tracy, Scott’s mistress of five years, came onstage to share her side of the story. Will Scott choose between his lover and his wife, or will both women kick him to the curb? Then, not everyone believes cheating is a bad thing. Holly Hill, author of Sugarbabe, says negotiated infidelity empowers women. She and her boyfriend, Dino, have been in an open relationship for three years, and they say this arrangement helps couples avoid strife and mistrust. What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, see a follow up with Charles, one of Dr. Phil’s most controversial guests, who wanted to explore a polyfidelity lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They beg, borrow, and expect others to pay their way… they’re moochers! First up, Connie wants her freeloading, pot-smoking son to get a life. Then, newlywed Hillary is already sick of supporting her rock star wannabe husband. She wants him to get off the couch and start earning his keep. And what if your own mother was mooching off of you? Dr. Phil thinks it’s time these moochers get a wake-up call!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Toni says her daughter, Kristine, is battling an alcohol addiction and has resorted to drinking hand sanitizer as a cheap way to get her fix. Kristine says her family is dysfunctional, and they’re the reason she can’t stay sober. Dr. Phil has words of warning for Kristine. After three failed stints in rehab, will she agree to try again -- or risk losing her daughter forever?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Are My Children in a Cult?
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Family At War: The Intervention (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Taking the plunge. Tying the knot. Gettin’ hitched. Call it what you like, but with over half of all marriages ending in divorce, you better know what you’re getting into. Today, Dr. Phil’s guests just can’t pull the trigger. Find out how the daughters from one man’s first marriage may be getting in the way; meet a pilot who can’t give up the bachelor lifestyle; and get to know a real “runaway bride.” Are their relationships strong enough to make a lasting marriage? Decide for yourself.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: Gente tranquila
programme.desc: En Moscú, una cadena de asesinatos desconcierta a la policía: en cada crimen muere el criminal que cometió el anterior, sin rastro del asesino. programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro

El Coronel Gustavo Camargo lideró esta misión casi suicida, negociando en las entrañas del grupo terrorista. Tras años de estrategia y paciencia, la monja fue liberada sin disparos ni violencia.

programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que la caja era un regalo de Leo y lee la carta que contenía. Así que va a hablar con él para decirle que se aleje de su nieta. Rebeca le pide a Adolfo que la entregue al novio en la renovación de los votos. Jimena les advierte que podría no ser una buena idea. Leonardo amenaza a Alejandra para que cambie su actitud. Esto pone furiosa a Alejandra y hace que decida desquitarse con Leo. Felipe le dice a Carlos Ernesto que el asesinato de su hermano no fue por motivos amorosos, y que podría haber tenido un enemigo. Irene, Maribel y Mateo van de viaje con Leonardo. A Irene la incómoda la cercanía de Leonardo y teme que se dé cuenta que el bebé es suyo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto quiere hacer el amor con Sol pero esta lo evita hasta que llega el punto en que Heriberto se cansa y la trata mal, llega Alejandro y lo detiene. Sol le dice a Heriberto que no puede estar con él y este se retira, le dice que no lo busque más. Aida le dice a Tabares que está siendo extorsionada por Heriberto y luego llama a Alejandro, le dice que para Heriberto es casi seguro que Sol y él no son hermanos. Alejandro se encuentra con el médico que le dice que el examen estuvo mal.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker está con Briggite en su casa. Está borracho y se abrazan Yubiri se sobresalta en la cama. NO puede dormir - tiene pálpitos y está pensando en Wilker. Se lo comenta a Graciela. Llega Bienvenida y lo le dicen nada. Yubiri no puede dormir y se levanta a tomar un vaso de agua. También tiene angustia y pálpitos. Llega Lolita con los mismos sustos y pálpitos y se entera que Wilker rompió con Solymar. Wilker está totalmente borracho y le dice a Briggite que le gusta y que quiere estar con ella.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se enfurece con Malaver por amenazar su capital. Margot conoce a Alejandro, mientras Marcelo y María del Pilar mantienen un romance secreto que horroriza a Manuela. Elizabeth y Moisés sufren al descubrir que son hermanos, luchando con sus sentimientos. Malaver hace una donación al barrio para ganarse a Manuela, pero Margot le advierte que él es en realidad Néstor Cordido. Katiuska manipula a Ricardo con una foto y planea hacerla pública para causar problemas.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor

Erasto, hundido, ordena a Arminda desaparecer a Rosa. Adolfo pide a Leticia que interceda para que Consuelo se case con él. Consuelo planea investigar a la familia de Arminda. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me - SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young".

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving in beautiful Mauritius Brent has his first taste of their curry. The Indian population has had a huge influence on the cuisine, but Mauritian curries are unique. Brent meets with Chef Vance to learn the distinctly Mauritian secrets to making curry as he's never made it before. Inspired by his previous trip to South Africa and the distinct textures and tastes of the Mauritian curry he decides to try his own hand at a fusion bunny chow. Heading into the local markets he overcomes language barriers as he struggles to source the ingredients. Finally, baguette in hand, he heads of to the famous colonial house, turned museum, Chateau De LaBourdonnais, where he cooks up at curry amazing feast under the tropical sun and mango trees.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.desc: Diego e Alicia estão na festa de aniversário do Porco-Espinho. Ele ama festas, especialmente a hora do balão de doces, a piñata, que acaba voando pelos ares!

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: A iguana verde e a fazenda de morangos
programme.desc: É época do Festival de Morangos! Um forte vento espalha todos os morangos e Alicia chama Diego para ajudar.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e a dupla de rãs de olhos vermelhos treinam para o Recital da Floresta, quando Alicia chama de um anfiteatro natural.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego está na África Central visitando Juma, que o apresenta ao novo bebê gorila, o próximo rei da montanha.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego anda de moto quando vê um esquilo voador tentando salvar um sagui pigmeu. Mas o sagui é muito pesado e Diego precisa ajudar o esquilo no resgate.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Diego e Dora levam o Bebê Monarca ao Festival
programme.desc: Diego e sua família estão no Festival das Borboletas Monarcas esperando as borboletas chegarem para o inverno. Dora avisa que um bebê monarca não sai do casulo.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: O pai de Diego apresenta um bicho muito especial, Louie Solitária, a tartaruga gigante. Louie é sozinho, pois ninguém nunca encontrou uma tartaruga como ele.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Alicia e Cauda Branca ao resgate!
programme.desc: Há um deslizamento de terra no deserto! Diego leva o veado para longe do perigo, enquanto Alicia checa se nenhum bichinho ficou para trás.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.desc: Diego e Kicho vão para o show dançante dos besouros. Com a ajuda da flauta mágica de Kicho, eles encolhem no tamanho dos insetos para entrarem pelo rio secreto.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: O marreco Willie encontra um amigo
programme.desc: Apesar de nunca ter visto uma onça antes, o marreco Willie conhece o Bebê Onça e os dois rapidamente se tornam amigos.

programme.title: Go, Diego, Go!
programme.sub-title: Freddie, o morcego, salva o Halloween!
programme.desc: É Halloween! Diego, Alicia e Freddie, o morcego, preparam-se para as "travessuras ou gostosuras", quando ouvem um pedido de ajuda. É a lhama!

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Brett se vê colocado em uma grande saia justa quando começa a duvidar do que anda sentindo pela Nutsa. A casa inteira começa a entrar em desespero quando eles resolvem se misturar buscando os verdadeiros pares ideais que faltam entre eles.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Asia resolve que irá tentar atrapalhar o relacionamento entre Samantha e Daniel. Os moradores da casa do "Are You The One?" têm uma última chance de conseguirem amor, dinheiro e mais um dia para lidarem com as consequências do que fizeram.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez na história, o amor não tem limites e todos são uma opção para os 16 solteiros que desembarcam no Havaí para encontrar um amor e ganhar R$1,000,000.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: O paraíso já começa apresentar os primeiros sinais do inferno que está por vir. Um casal tem problemas devido a possibilidade de um relacionamento aberto. Triângulos amorosos começam a surgir na casa.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Depois do baile LGBTQ+, a casa fica literal e figurativamente uma bagunça. A bruxa está solta para dois casais da casa. Dionne Slay chega no recinto.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Um ménage a cinco agita a dinâmica. A tendência autodestrutiva do Justin ameaça sua relação com Max. Danny faz uma conexão.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa está determinada em descobrir qual dos casais é um par ideal. Jonathan está determinado em romper as barreiras do amor. Kai apronta na frente da Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Jonathan tenta fazer as pazes com Basit. Um casal se aproxima enquanto outros lutam para superar seus comportamentos tóxicos na relação.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Amigos e familiares colocam a casa abaixo. Jenna está dividida entre a estratégia e seu coração. Uma visita ao Quarto do Sexo tem consequências explosivas.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa tenta consertar os estragos causados pelo comportamento predatório do Kai que causou muita confusão. Remy tenta deixar seu passado de pegação pra trás para conquistar a Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Três casais encontram os seus pares ideais enquanto dois casais têm péssimas notícias. Justin e Max encontram a resposta que procuravam. Paige luta para derrubar suas barreiras.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Enquanto a casa luta para determinar os três últimos casais, uma pessoa tem certeza que sabe quem é o seu par. O novos pares ideais recém confirmados tentam se conhecer melhor.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Em sua última chance de ganhar o prêmio e sem mais cartas na manga, a casa precisa confiar que os seis atrasados seguirão seus corações para encontrar seus pares ideais. Amber está indecisa.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.sub-title: Quão Longe Você Iria Pelo Amor?
programme.desc: 22 solteiros de todo o mundo tentam encontrar o seu par ideal e ganhar 1 milhão de dólares.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.sub-title: Quão Longe Você Iria Pelo Amor? Parte 2
programme.desc: Uma noite, um casal se separa e segue para outros relacionamentos, enquanto outros casais pensam que acharam “a pessoa certa”.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um caubói desorientado está encharcado de suor, salivando e urinando em excesso, ninguém sabe por quê. Uma haste de metal está empalada na cabeça de uma jovem. Duas adolescentes estão com falta de ar, o que andaram fazendo?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Os médicos lutam para salvar um jovem levado à emergência congelado em sem pulso. Um homem fica fatalmente doente na sua festa de aniversário. Um segredo vergonhoso impede que um paciente corra para a sala de cirurgia para ser operado.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um médico precisa tomar uma difícil decisão se reanima ou não um paciente idoso com uma parada cardiorrespiratória. Duas enfermeiras encontram uma vítima de esfaqueamento na rua. Uma médica em um cruzeiro descobre que a sua viagem se tornou um pesadelo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem tem um choque anafilático. Um cara forte tem medo de agulha. Um homem se esfaqueia com uma espada ninja. Um paciente precisa de exorcismo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um paciente psiquiátrico tem uma paixão extrema por pudim de chocolate. Um paciente em choque anafilático pode ser alérgico à sua namorada. Um homem que está com o rosto bizarramente inchado precisa ser convencido a se tratar.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Na véspera de Natal, um homem vestido de Papai Noel está à beira da morte e a sua esposa pede um favor especial ao médico: coletar o sêmen de seu marido. Um homem não consegue respirar porque um peixe vivo está preso em sua garganta.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um garoto de seis anos sofre um derrame que ameaça a sua vida. Um homem está com um fogão de acampamento preso em seu pênis. Um jovem médico da emergência fica preocupado quando lhe pedem para verificar a saúde da esposa de outro médico.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: A Dra. Alexandra Dresel é testada quando uma vítima de assalto chega à emergência com duas balas no cérebro. O Dr. Mauricio Heilbron Jr. precisa testar seu autocontrole quando recebe dois casos complicados.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quando um bebê aparentemente saudável desenvolve repentinamente deficiência de oxigênio, a Dra. Beth Schissel encara um mistério médico. Quando a polícia leva ao hospital um homem desarrumado, a Dra. Kivela acha que há algum segredo sobre ele.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O Ecstasy e a Agonia. Doido Nu Esfaqueia Vítima. Salvando Duas Trompas. Árvore no Pescoço.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quem Mexe Com cobra é Picado. Entrega no Estacionamento. Explosão de HIV. O Homem de 270 quilos. O Bolo da Mãe Que Está Morrendo.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher fica mais de 18 horas presa em um vaso sanitário. Os médicos se esforçam para salvar a vida de um homem mutilado por um triturador. Quando uma enfermeira desmaia no hospital, os médicos e membros da equipe fazem uma descoberta chocante.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Médicos fazem uma incisão peitoral enquanto aguardam o cirurgião. Uma iguana chega ao hospital com um paciente de um acidente de carro.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma vítima de picada de cobra pode morrer na emergência porque o antídoto que a salvará está em falta. Um paciente que não para de se masturbar testa uma estagiária. O coração de uma mulher para após uma cesárea.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: "O Gooch" volta para provocar o Arnold e mira em um novo alvo -- Sam -- só para enfrentar o seu novo desafio contra o novo vizinho de Drummond, uma estudante de intercâmbio italiana.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Visando ser eleito diretor de entretenimento para um fundo de caridade escolar, Arnold promete conseguir uma celebridade -- mas quando chega a hora, ele é forçado a pedir ajuda à sua inimiga Carmella, esperando que ela possa salvar o dia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O empreendedor Arnold reluta em permitir que Sam faça parte do seu novo esquema, quando Sam percebe que apenas Arnold ficará com os lucros, ele acaba com a parceria e vira um concorrente.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma surpresa de Drummond, destinada a animar uma esperança olímpica caída em um trágico acidente, tem o efeito oposto, já que o jovem fica amargurado no encontro dos medalhistas de ouro.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Os Drummond ficam preocupados quando o normalmente adorável Sam luta contra um cínico idoso que rejeita o programa dos escoteiros "Adote um Avô", deixando Sam com uma imagem errada das pessoas mais velhas.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam convence um relutante Sr. Drummond a se tornar o treinador do seu fracassado time de basquete e depois se arrepende quando ele aparece no banco de reservas.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam é pego de surpresa quando ele percebe que seu novo "colega" é uma menina, mas o Sr. Drummond fica ainda mais boquiaberto quando os garotos desejam fazer uma festa de pijama.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Kimberly volta para casa de sua escola em Paris para surpreender Drummond em seu aniversário, fazendo com que Arnold e Willis tentem combinar aquele presente especial até que Willis pense em algo melhor.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando o foguete do projeto de Arnol para a escola é acidentalmente disparado e pousa sobre a embaixada russa, o departamento de estado é levado a suspeitar da participação de Drummond em algum ato criminoso.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A tentativa de Arnold para impedir que um amigo beba dá errado, quando ele é deixado diante do banheiro masculino segurando uma garrafa de bebida no momento em que um professor chega, em um episódio especial que lida com o alcoolismo na adolescência.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma viagem para acampamento com Arnold e Sam que tinha a intenção de fortalecer o relacionamento de Drummond com Sam dá errado quando o verdadeiro pai de Sam aparece e o convida a se juntar a ele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.sub-title: A beleza está nos olhos de Arnold
programme.desc: Arnold se vê diante de um dilema quando seus amigos insistem para que ele chame uma linda chefe de torcida para dançar, ao invés da garota que Arnold realmente gosta, a qual eles consideram uma "patinha feia."

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Após ser assaltado no caminho da escola para casa, Arnold insiste para que Sam e Willis não contem ao Sr. Drummond.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A nova amizade de Arnold e Sam com uma dançarina de rua fica repleta de medo e confusão quando eles descobrem que ela tem epilepsia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam e Arnold temem que o tempo que seus pais estão passando separados seja sintoma de um casamento que está ruindo e os meninos tentam reacender o romance deles, esperando que seja a solução para evitar o divórcio.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Proteger Ramona, a namorada do valentão da escola, parece uma tarefa simples para Arnold, até que seu "charme Jackson" natural cria alguns problemas - Ramona se apaixona perdidamente por ele - e Herman, o valentão, quer arrebentar a cara dele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O sonho de Arnold de se tornar um sucesso "da noite para o dia" como fotojornalista se torna realidade quando ele consegue seu primeiro emprego em um jornal local.x

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma família cujo filho pequeno morreu, obriga o pai a sequestrar Sam, que está comprando salgadinhos em uma mercearia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Os Drummond, desesperados, vão ao noticiário para tentar trazer Sam de volta. Enquanto isso, Sam arrisca tudo para contar aos Drummond onde ele está.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.sub-title: It's My Party & I'll Cry If I Want To
programme.desc: O Sr. Drummond faz de tudo para que Sam tenha uma festa de aniversário inesquecível, arranjando uma personalidade da televisão local para ser a atração principal, até que o "Capitão Jack" rouba o show e o aniversariante abandona o navio.

programme.title: iCarly: Chocando o mundo Parte 1
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie decidem dedicar um programa ao humorista e apresentador de televisão Jimmy Fallon, depois que ele menciona iCarly em seu show. Impressionado pelo gesto, Jimmy convida os três amigos para irem a Nova York.

programme.title: iCarly: Chocando o mundo Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie decidem dedicar um programa ao humorista e apresentador de televisão Jimmy Fallon, depois que ele menciona iCarly em seu show. Impressionado pelo gesto, Jimmy convida os três amigos para irem a Nova York.

programme.title: iCarly: Pega ladrão!
programme.desc: Sam descobre que seu computador portátil desapareceu e dá a Freddie o número de série do equipamento para que ele possa localizar a câmera do computador e a ativar.

programme.title: iCarly: O adeus Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly está se conformando em não ir ao baile anual quando, de repente, seu pai aparece para acompanha-la. Além disso, sua noite tem mais uma surpresa quando seu pai a faz uma pergunta que mudará sua vida para sempre.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Quando Ms. Briggs reprova todos os participantes favoritos de Sam e Carly no show de talentos da escola, as duas garotas decidem criar uma página na internet e fazer um show semanal para mostrar o que elas quiserem.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly está apaixonada por um garoto de sua escola chamado Jake. Quando ela descobre que o garoto terminou seu namoro, ela aproveita a oportunidade para conquista-lo.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly e Sam competem com Freddie e Spencer para ver quem consegue chamar mais gente para ver o programa. Mas, quando as coisas não saem conforme o planejado, tudo vira uma grande confusão.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie querem que seu show seja comentado no Nevelocity, um popular site da internet que avalia programas e determina diretamente a sua popularidade entre os jovens.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: O avô de Spencer acha que ele é muito irresponsável e louco para ser o responsável de Carly. Agora, ela e seus amigos precisam provar ao vovô que ele é, sim, capaz de cumprir essa tarefa.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie tentam quebrar o recorde mundial pelo mais longo e contínuo programa. Para isso, iCarly terá de ficar no ar por mais de 24 horas seguidas!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Valerie, uma fã do iCarly, chama Freddie para um encontro. Eles se dão tão bem que Freddie começa a gravar o programa de Valerie.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly convida o ídolo das artes de Spencer, Harry Joyner, para conhecer o trabalho de seu irmão. Mas, quando Harry comenta que o trabalho de Spancer é amador, o garoto sente que sua vida já não tem nenhum propósito.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Mandy, a maior fã do iCarly, é convidada para assistir sozinha à gravação no estúdio. Mas Mandy se mostra tão inconveniente, que eles têm de se livrar dela.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly e Sam decidem cuidar de ovos para um projeto de ciências. O problema é que os pintinhos nascem antes do esperado e acabam fugindo da incubadora. Agora, as duas amigas precisam encontrar os pintinhos perdidos.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly dá a Sam uma camiseta única e exclusiva de iCarly para comemorar a amizade entre elas. Mas, quando Sam vende a peça para comprar ingressos, as duas melhores amigas acabam brigando.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly pede aos fãs que mandem vídeos de suas danças mais legais. Mas, quando mais de mil clipes chegam, Carly, Sam e Freddie lutam para assistir a todos eles.

programme.title: iCarly: O Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie fazem o iCarly em um apartamento "assombrado". Entretanto, coisas estranhas começam a acontecer e os amigos se apavoram: a fama do local deve ser real!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer salva a vida do vocalista da banda Plain White Ts e o convence a ir ao iCarly. Entretanto, coisas estranhas acontecem e tudo dá errado na hora da transmissão.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Sam é detida exatamente na noite do show especial de iCarly número 50. Impossibilitados de transmitirem o programa, Carly e Freddie fazem de tudo para serem presos também.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly está muito emocionada quando uma empresa famosa de sapatos chamada Daka entra em contato com ela para promover seus calçados no programa. O problema é que os sapatos são horrorosos!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly tira uma nota B em uma prova de História, mas está convencida de que merecia um A. Sam encontra a oportunidade perfeita durante uma reunião semanal com o Diretor Franklin e muda a nota de Carly no computador.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Uma grande produtora quer transformar iCarly num programa de televisão. Mas Carly, Sam e Freddie logo se irritam com todas as exigências necessárias.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: O namoro de Sam está atrapalhando as gravações do programa on-line de Carly, por isso, Carly e Freddie vão fazer de tudo para separá-los.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Depois de assistirem um segmento do programa iCarly na qual um homem vende cópias piratas de filmes, dois detetives decidem usar o apartamento de Carly e Spencer como posto de vigilância.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly recebe uma proposta de uma famosa e exclusiva escola privada chamada Briarwood para estudar lá com uma bolsa de estudos integral. Ela está em dúvida, mas Sam e Freedie sabem que precisam fazer a amiga mudar de opinião.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Freedie sente que precisa passar menos tempo com as garotas, por isso decide acompanhar Spencer em suas aulas de esgrima. Como o garoto resulta ser um esgrimista nato, Spencer o faz competir contra o incrível Doug Toder.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Ilha Judiciária! Enies Lobby à Vista!
programme.desc: O trem se aproxima de Enies Lobby, e as palavras gentis de Franky chegam a Robin. O trem de Luffy e companhia sai de seu curso, mas o grupo ganha um poderoso novo aliado!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Começa a Operação de Desembarque! Avancem, Chapéus de Palha!
programme.desc: Os Chapéus de Palha planejam resgatar Robin, mas, como sempre, Luffy não dispensa briga. Sua impulsividade atrapalhará a missão?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Invade o Inimigo! O Grande Confronto na Ilha Judiciária!
programme.desc: Luffy consegue chegar à ilha principal, mas o ataque da Família Franky é detido por um par de gigantes furiosos!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Batalha Contra Gigantes! Abram o Segundo Portão!
programme.desc: Luffy dá cabo de centenas de soldados, a Família Franky derruba um dos gigantes e os assassinos da CP9 prestam contas a Spandam!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Achem Um Caminho! O Homem-Foguete Alça Voo!
programme.desc: Zoro's quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Alcancem Luffy! Os Chapéus de Palha Lutam Com Tudo!
programme.desc: Nami eletrocuta o inimigo com um ataque Clima Tact, mas os bandidos cercam os Chapéus de Palha até que a Família Franky apareça com alguns monstros marinhos!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Robin Traída! A Real Intenção do Governo Mundial!
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, Nami e Chopper tentam alcançar seu capitão, Soge King não está em lugar algum, e Luffy corre de cabeça para uma batalha com Blueno!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Devolvam a Robin! Luffy vs. Blueno!
programme.desc: Luffy mostra sua nova força em combate contra Blueno, da CP9, e Sogeking se torna amigo de gigantes!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Não Parem! Ativem o Sinal de Contra-Ataque!
programme.desc: Enquanto Luffy confronta Blueno, os amigos gigantes de Sogeking mostram sua força e assassinos da CP9 ingerem Frutos do Diabo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Quase no Luffy! Reunidos na Praça da Corte!
programme.desc: Um Yagara cego luta até o último suspiro para deixar os Chapéus de Palha mais perto de seu capitão. Luffy ativa a Segunda Marcha para proteger seus companheiros dos poderosos inimigos!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Tudo Para Proteger Meus Companheiros! Segunda Marcha Ativada!
programme.desc: Luffy derrota Blueno em combate com seu voraz novo estilo de luta e o covarde Spandam treme diante da aproximação dos Chapéus de Palha!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Responda-nos, Robin! O Grito de Guerra dos Chapéus de Palha!
programme.desc: Luffy e seu bando finalmente estão reunidos e prontos para resgatar Robin, mas a Filha do Demônio reluta em aceitar a ajuda de seus companheiros, apesar dos pedidos de Franky.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: O Passado de Robin! A Menina Que Foi Chamada de Demônio!
programme.desc: O passado Robin mostra a busca de uma menina pelo conhecimento proibido e seu encontro com um amistoso gigante.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Destino de Mãe e Filha! O Nome da Mãe é Olvia!
programme.desc: O passado de Robin continua com a chegada de Olvia e a cruel e brutal invasão da pacífica ilha de Ohara pelo Governo Mundial!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Tragédia de Ohara! O Terror do Chamado da Destruição!
programme.desc: O Professor Clover revela uma sinistra teoria sobre o Governo Mundial, Robin reencontra sua mãe e o gigante se une à luta!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Diga Que Quer Viver! Nós Somos Seus Companheiros!
programme.desc: A tormentuosa história de Ohara e a juventude de Robin chegam a uma trágica conclusão. Luffy declara guerra ao Governo Mundial e Robin enfim decide viver!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Avancem Sobre a Cachoeira! Os Sentimentos de Luffy!
programme.desc: Os Chapéus de Palha estão prontos para começar a batalha por Robin, mas, primeiro, Luffy volta às memórias de sua infância, e ao homem que o fez querer se tornar um pirata!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Os Caminhos de Homens! As Técnicas de Zoro, os Sonhos de Usopp!
programme.desc: Zoro se recorda de seu primeiro encontro com Luffy, e Usopp, dos eventos que o levaram a juntar-se aos Chapéus de Palha!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Um Laço de Amizade Tecido por Lágrimas! O Mapa Mundi de Nami.
programme.desc: O passado desolador de Nami e a épica batalha de Luffy contra Arlong, nos primeiros dias dos Chapéus de Palha, são relembrados!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Partir Constrói o Caráter de um Homem! Sanji e Chopper!
programme.desc: Os eventos que levaram Sanji do Baratie aos Chapéus de Palha e a história do passado de Chopper em uma ilha coberta de neve são relembrados.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Tudo por seus Companheiros! Robin nas Trevas!
programme.desc: Memórias revelam a motivação de Robin em ajudar a CP9, a chocante descoberta de Nami sobre o passado da arqueóloga e a determinação de Luffy em salvar sua companheira!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eu Não Entregarei os Projetos! A Decisão de Franky!
programme.desc: Franky enfrenta Spandam destruindo o maior desejo do louco, e o som de um trem marítimo leva os Chapéus de Palha a dar um salto de fé!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Obtenham as Cinco Chaves! Os Chapéus de Palha vs. CP9!
programme.desc: Luffy corre para resgatar Robin enquanto os demais Chapéus de Palha partem em busca das cinco chaves necessárias para soltar a arqueóloga!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Usuários de Frutos do Diabo! Kaku e Jabra se Transformam!
programme.desc: Enquanto Usopp e Zoro enfrentam uma dupla de animais assassinos, Sanji ensina a arte do chá à mais bela integrante do CP9!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eu Não Vou Chutá-la Nem que Custe Minha Vida! O Cavalheirismo de Sanji!
programme.desc: Luffy se mete em enrascada tentando alcançar Robin, e Usopp e Zoro acabam algemados um no outro. Sanji, incapaz de enfrentar Kalifa, acaba seriamente ferido!

programme.title: Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Nilsa tem que fazer malabarismo para lidar com a situação de ter dois ex na casa, e definitivamente, ela não está pronta para deixar nenhum dos dois livre. Aimee procura ajuda de uma advogado para lidar com a situação dos seus problemas.

programme.title: Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Nova cidade, nova casa, novo drama. Metade da casa está namorando, mas uma primeira noite selvagem e louca em São Petersburgo parece mudar tudo isso.

programme.title: Floribama Shore
programme.desc: Candace está chateada sobre a escolha de quartos e surta com Nilsa e com Aimee. A galera se reúne para dar a Aimee uma festa de formatura do curso de controle da raiva, e um deles é levado de ambulância.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Junte-se a esse grupo de quatro garotos e quatro garotas que passarão juntos seis semanas em Newcastle. No primeiro dia, eles se conhecem, conversam e já começam a primeira festa de Geordie Shore.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Jay sabe que está se encaminhando para algo mais sério com Vicky e isso o traz diversos problemas na hora de sair para festas com o grupo, Charlotte tenta combater a ação de Gaz com outras garotas.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Holly recebe a visita do namorado e Charlotte não resiste aos encantos de Gaz.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Com a saída de Holly, o clima da casa muda para pior.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Supreendentemente, Holly volta à casa do Gordie Shore. Enquanto isso, Jaz e Gaz tentam cumprir com uma nova tarefa dada pela dona do local, Anna, na qual eles deverão trabalhar em um clube noturno.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Certamente não existe um final feliz como nos contos de fadas nesse final de temporada de Geordie Shore. Gaz dá a Charlotte uma notícia muito grave, enquanto a relação de Jay e Vicky entra em ebulição de maneira impactante.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Geordie Shore está de volta para mais uma temporada cheia de drama, bebedeiras e loucuras.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Vicky não consegue resolver seus sentimentos. Charlotte perde a paciência com o comportamento de Gaz. E rebecca enfrenta a competição pela atenção de um dos rapazes.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: O humor da casa muda com a saída de Charlotte. Ricci e Vicky são interrompidos por um visitante inesperado. E a festa não acaba nunca para Gary e James.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: James está numa maré de sorte com as mulheres e Gary consegue convencer Charlotte a voltar ao grupo.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Charlotte tenta esquecer o passado. Vicky e Ricci assumem o relacionamento para o choque de alguns dos moradores da casa.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light tenta descobrir onde Mello e da máfia se escondem.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mello entra na sede da SPK para recuperar uma foto dele e certificar-se de não ser morto por Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Near contata o novo quartel geral da força especial e determina que Kira está entre os seus integrantes.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A estrela locutora de notícias Kiyomi Takada se torna a porta-voz mundial de Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light tem como objetivo investigar Kiyomi, enquanto os integrantes do corpo especial escutam pelo auto-falante.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Aizawa percebe o que está acontecendo e alerta Near, o qual já sabia sobre as notas.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light dá a Kiyomi a ordem para matar Near.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: De acordo com o acerto, Near e o SPK se encontram com Light e o corpo especial em um armazém.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Embora Mikami tenha escrito os nomes de todos no Death Note, estavam vivos. Near consegue o Death Note e tudo é revelado.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: O brilhante, mas entediado estudante da escola Light Yagami encontra-se mantendo o poder da vida e da morte em suas mãos, o Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Enquanto os criminosos do mundo continuam a morrer, L atende representantes de várias nações.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Ryuk o Shinigami que deixou cair o Death Note no mundo humano, avisa a Light que alguém está no seu encalço.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conhecido mundialmente como Kira, prova a extensão dos poderes do Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami exige uma reunião em pessoa com L quando ele descobre que ele secretamente levou agentes do FBI para o Japão.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light se reune com uma mulher no departamento de polícia, pois tem uma mensagem importante para o Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light usa o Death Note para tentar se livrar de uma mulher que poderia ter levado para a prisão.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: L coloca microfones e câmeras nas casas dos membros do grupo especial, incluindo a casa de Yagami, mas Light dá um passo a frente.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Os assassinatos continuam, e L começa a suspeitar do comportamento perfeito de Light que então decide investigar por conta própria.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: As suspeitas de L estão cada vez maior, e Light o convence a convidá-lo para a investigação.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como previsto nas fitas enviadas a TV Sakura, apresentadores e comentaristas de notícias expressaram suas dúvidas sobre a morte de Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Com um segundo Kira solto, L pede Light para se unir ao grupo especial para descobrir o paradeiro do verdadeiro Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light viaja a Aoyama para descobrir a identidade do segundo Kira antes que L suspeite mais ainda.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light e Misa mostram seus Death Notes, então Light pede que Misa use sua Rem Shinigami para se livrar de L.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Há evidências que apontam para Misa Amane como o segundo Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa está presa, embora suas lembranças do Death Note tenham sido excluídas.
